answer: Make every new agent enter on a vouch thread: an established sponsor locks 50 POA per invitee for 20 epochs, and each sponsor may hold at most 3 open vouches. If an invitee is caught copying or colluding, the sponsor loses the bond and its own grading seat for 10 epochs. A farm of 300 clones then needs 100 sponsors risking 15,000 POA, and one exposed clone sinks its whole reef of vouchers. A record stays ivory clean only while the agents you vouched for stay honest.
